scenarios.title: Recover document revisions through lease handover and restore
plannedActions: POST commands ending deletion and new scene
POST commands old lease current epoch
expectedOutcomes: Two scenes persist exactly at version one and sequence one, with exact receipt and event before=null. All steps compare current live items, tombstones, epoch, head, timing and ordered event payloads with independent authored expectations.

Acquire fence one then renew its unchanged identity/token/fence with a later bounded expiry; public listing omits token. All steps compare current live items, tombstones, epoch, head, timing and ordered event payloads with independent authored expectations.

DELETE returns ok and removes the active public lease without changing document/events. All steps compare current live items, tombstones, epoch, head, timing and ordered event payloads with independent authored expectations.

Reacquisition advances fence to two with a new token; old released proof is refused with no document/event mutation. All steps compare current live items, tombstones, epoch, head, timing and ordered event payloads with independent authored expectations.

Valid proof cannot be used under a different command session; active lease is unchanged. All steps compare current live items, tombstones, epoch, head, timing and ordered event payloads with independent authored expectations.

Delete receipt/event retain deleted before/after content while public tombstone strips data and retains version two. All steps compare current live items, tombstones, epoch, head, timing and ordered event payloads with independent authored expectations.

A put at tombstone version two restores the same identity at version three with exact receipt and deletion-to-live event. All steps compare current live items, tombstones, epoch, head, timing and ordered event payloads with independent authored expectations.

Delete second scene and add later scene atomically at sequence four; retain exact tombstone and event before/after values. All steps compare current live items, tombstones, epoch, head, timing and ordered event payloads with independent authored expectations.

Historical sequence two returns only Ending plus empty-data Opening tombstone at version two; sequence three returns recovered Opening v3 and Ending v1; wrong requested epoch is rejected. All steps compare current live items, tombstones, epoch, head, timing and ordered event payloads with independent authored expectations.

Restore sequence one resurrects Ending at v3, returns Opening at v4, tombstones later scene at v2, advances epoch to two/timing one, and invalidates active leases. All steps compare current live items, tombstones, epoch, head, timing and ordered event payloads with independent authored expectations.

Exact old delete request returns original sequence-two receipt after restoration without mutating epoch-two document or events; modified replay is command_reused. All steps compare current live items, tombstones, epoch, head, timing and ordered event payloads with independent authored expectations.

Fresh command with old epoch is rejected before editing restored content. All steps compare current live items, tombstones, epoch, head, timing and ordered event payloads with independent authored expectations.

Current epoch and correct version with the pre-restore lease fails lease_required. All steps compare current live items, tombstones, epoch, head, timing and ordered event payloads with independent authored expectations.

New epoch lease advances fence to three; stale item version is version_conflict despite fresh valid lease. All steps compare current live items, tombstones, epoch, head, timing and ordered event payloads with independent authored expectations.

Fresh restore beyond head rejects invalid_sequence; old epoch restore rejects stale_epoch; both leave tombstones/history intact. All steps compare current live items, tombstones, epoch, head, timing and ordered event payloads with independent authored expectations.

History pagination after sequence three returns exact command four then restore five, hasMore true then false; before/after changes and restore snapshotRequired are asserted. All steps compare current live items, tombstones, epoch, head, timing and ordered event payloads with independent authored expectations.

Wait until actual lease expiry without clock or storage injection; old proof is refused and active lease list empties. All steps compare current live items, tombstones, epoch, head, timing and ordered event payloads with independent authored expectations.

Reacquire expired lease at fence four, save correct version in epoch two, and preserve unrelated restored Ending and later-scene tombstone. All steps compare current live items, tombstones, epoch, head, timing and ordered event payloads with independent authored expectations. Reuse the refused version-conflict command ID with corrected bytes: failed attempts did not reserve a successful receipt.
